t: This is Untitled (Listening), a sculpture by Antony Gormley. Gormley is a British sculptor, best known for the Angel of the North, a public sculpture in Gateshead, erected in 1998. He also made Another Place on Crosby Beach near Liverpool, and Event Horizon, a multipart installation that premiered in London in 2007 and later travelled to New York, São Paulo and Hong Kong. Take a moment to look at how the work sits in its surroundings.
